"""Owned tiny debug GPU checks after closed source/build/host qualification."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native_copy_tiny_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
reference = json.loads((B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v5/sample-9-workers-4-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/record.json').read_text())
assert reference['passed'] and reference['complete'] and not reference['active']
build_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v2/record.json'
review_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-host-review-root-v3/record.json'
pub_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-host-publication-root-v2/record.json'
build, review, publication = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in [build_path, review_path, pub_path]]
assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] and not d['active'] for d in [build, review, publication])
assert review['lints_qualified'] and review['actual_host_asan_ubsan_instrumentation_proved']
health_command = next(c for c in reference['commands'] if c['label'] == 'health-before')
ENV = dict(health_command['environment'])
ENV.update(ZE_ENABLE_VALIDATION_LAYER='1', ZE_ENABLE_PARAMETER_VALIDATION='1', ZEL_ENABLE_LOADER_LOGGING='1',
           ZEL_LOADER_LOG_CONSOLE='1', ZEL_LOADER_LOGGING_LEVEL='trace', ZEL_LOADER_LOGGING_ENABLE_SUCCESS_PRINT='1')
FAULT = re.compile(reference['kernel-final']['filter'], re.I)
EXPECTED_LIBRARIES = set(reference['health-before']['self_maps'])
RELEVANT_MODULE = re.compile(r'/(?:libsycl|libur_|libumf|libze_)[^/]*$')


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-tiny-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             model_executed=False, gpu_executed=False, adopted=False, reset_executed=False,
             boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
             source_revision=publication['commit'], source_pins=build['source_pins'],
             qualification_receipts={str(p): m.sha(p) for p in [build_path, review_path, pub_path]},
             environment=ENV, expected_provider_libraries=sorted(EXPECTED_LIBRARIES),
             raw_log_budget_bytes=64 << 20, case_log_budget_bytes=8 << 20,
             scope='Tiny transfers/events/role/normal-close only; no Prefill/model/quality/speed/fullcontext admission',
             api_logging_reference='https://github.com/oneapi-src/level-zero/blob/master/README.md#logging-api-calls')

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def observe(label, wall):
        def interaction(io, entry):
            io.proc.stdin.close()
            deadline = time.monotonic() + wall
            libraries = set()
            reads = 0
            while not io.exit_watch.poll(0) or not io.eof:
                io.poll()
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'finite fixture deadline'
                io.read()
                io.pending.clear()
                if not io.exit_watch.poll(0) and reads < 256:
                    identity = m.identity(entry['pid'])
                    if identity:
                        assert identity['start_ticks'] == entry['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
                        assert identity['sid'] == entry['pid']
                        try:
                            text = Path(f"/proc/{entry['pid']}/maps").read_text()
                            assert len(text.encode()) <= 1 << 20
                            libraries.update(line.split()[-1] for line in text.splitlines()
                                             if line.split() and RELEVANT_MODULE.search(line.split()[-1]))
                        except FileNotFoundError:
                            pass
                        reads += 1
                time.sleep(0.02)
            r.setdefault('actual_library_maps', {})[label] = dict(paths=sorted(libraries), bounded_reads=reads,
                identity_scope='Owned direct PID/start_ticks/session anchor only; filtered modules, no polling trace retained')
            save()
        return interaction

    def run(label, argv, env=ENV, gpu=False, allowed=(0,), wall=60):
        print('OWNED TINY CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        if gpu:
            r['gpu_executed'] = True
            save()
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, interaction=observe(label, wall) if gpu else None,
                             wall=wall, cpu=120, rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return stdout, stderr, c

    def kernel(label):
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '--after-cursor', r['kernel_cursor'], '--no-pager', '-o', 'json'])
        entries = [json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        faults = [entry for entry in entries if FAULT.search(str(entry.get('MESSAGE', '')))]
        dump_present = (Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:05:00.0/devcoredump/data').exists())
        r.setdefault('kernel_checks', {})[label] = dict(filter=FAULT.pattern, fault_entries=faults,
            relevant_entries=[entry for entry in entries if re.search(r'\bxe\b|0000:05:00.0|drm|guc', str(entry.get('MESSAGE', '')), re.I)],
            dump_present=dump_present, command_exit=0)
        save()
        assert not faults and not dump_present, 'fresh GPU fault gate'

    def health(label):
        stdout, _, _ = run(label, health_command['argv'], gpu=True)
        lines = stdout.splitlines()
        assert 'PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words' in lines
        libraries = [line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in lines if line.startswith('LIBRARY ')]
        assert 1 <= len(libraries) <= 512 and set(libraries) == EXPECTED_LIBRARIES
        r.setdefault('health_checks', {})[label] = dict(pass_line='PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words',
            mapping_rows=len(libraries), unique_libraries=sorted(set(libraries)))
        save()

    try:
        for path, digest in build['source_pins'].items():
            assert m.sha(W / path) == digest
        stdout, _, _ = run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        assert stdout.strip() == publication['commit']
        stdout, _, _ = run('source-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not stdout.strip()
        stdout, _, _ = run('embedding-state', ['/usr/bin/systemctl', '--user', 'show', 'llama-server-qwen3embed.service', '-p', 'ActiveState'])
        assert stdout.strip() == 'ActiveState=inactive'
        stdout, _, _ = run('kernel-cursor', ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '-n', '0', '--show-cursor', '--no-pager'])
        match = re.search(r'-- cursor: (\S+)', stdout)
        assert match
        r['kernel_cursor'] = match.group(1)
        kernel('kernel-before')
        stdout, _, _ = run('device-selected', ['/usr/bin/xpu-smi', 'discovery', '-d', '0', '-j'])
        r['device_discovery'] = json.loads(stdout)
        assert '0000:05:00.0' in stdout
        r['health_binary_sha256'] = m.sha(Path(health_command['argv'][0]))
        health('health-before')
        kernel('kernel-after-prehealth')
        for name, flag, option in [('free-generic', '0', '--require-generic'), ('free-native', '1', '--require-native')]:
            binary = Path(build['binaries']['free']['native_copy_stream_test']['path'])
            assert m.sha(binary) == build['binaries']['free']['native_copy_stream_test']['sha256']
            env = dict(ENV, STRATA_COPY_ENGINE=flag)
            stdout, stderr, c = run(name, [str(binary), option], env, gpu=True, allowed=(0, 77))
            assert c['exit_code'] == 0, 'requested route unavailable; not a pass'
            assert 'ROUTE native=' + flag in stdout and 'PASS native-copy fixture drained' in stdout
            assert EXPECTED_LIBRARIES <= set(r['actual_library_maps'][name]['paths'])
            if flag == '1':
                assert 'native copy-only queue selected group=' in stderr and 'ownership=keep' in stderr
            r.setdefault('cases', {})[name] = dict(passed=True, complete=True, exit_code=0, flag=flag,
                binary_sha256=m.sha(binary), scope='Actual tiny copy/event/canary/role/normal teardown')
            kernel('kernel-after-' + name)
            health('health-after-' + name)
            kernel('kernel-posthealth-' + name)
        r['boot_unchanged'] = Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip() == r['boot_id']
        assert r['boot_unchanged']
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, native_tiny_route_qualified=True, model_qualified=False)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        if owner.active is None and r.get('kernel_cursor'):
            try:
                kernel('kernel-final-after-failure')
            except BaseException as fault_error:
                r['final_fault_error'] = repr(fault_error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'gpu_executed', 'native_tiny_route_qualified', 'model_qualified']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
